summary: A parent of a Montgomery County student urges the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding but to impose stricter CIPA enforcement and parental controls to curb digital distraction.

claims.argument: Digital distraction on school devices undermines learning and exposes children to inappropriate content, so stricter CIPA enforcement is needed.
claims.evidence_quote: ornographic content, all of which is far more pervasive on the internet now than it was when E-Rate began. The FCC should strengthen its enforcement of the Children’s Internet Protection Act (CIPA)
